subject: util.c: Don't leak directory handle if recursive call to dirRemove fails (#12800)
reason: The change adds closedir() on an error path of dirRemove() in util.c to avoid leaking a directory handle when a recursive removal fails. dirRemove has no callers anywhere in the Valkey source (only its declaration in util.h), so the code is unreachable from any command, persistence, or replication path; and even with a caller, the fix only frees a file descriptor on a failure path that requires an externally induced filesystem error, with no observable change in replies, data, or control flow. No fuzzer scenario can reach or observe this fix.
